returns._0: recorded false only for an exact retry of the already recorded transition (no state change).

acceptHostOwner(bytes32,(address[],uint8.notice: The proposed owner accepts and, in the same write, replaces the reporter quorum and policy.

cancelReservation(bytes32).notice: After its deadline an unconsumed reservation returns to its payer and frees its dedup slots.

deactivateHost((bytes32,uint64,address,u.notice: Graceful shutdown by the locally stored operator or accepted owner (msg.sender; no ERC1271).

fundHostOffline(bytes32).notice: Only the budget's payer adds funds, so every wei in a host budget has one entitled payer.

get(bytes32).notice: Schema-5 row; `active` is true iff the canonical lifecycle state is Online.

publishTrustAnchor(address[],uint8,uint3.notice: Anyone may publish; an anchor has no power until a payer names it in a signed reservation AND the         owner binds it in the enrollment intent. There is no setter: a new version is a new anchorId.

recordHostOffline((bytes32,uint64,addres.notice: Enrolled EOA reporter quorum records Offline for the exact current generation and revision.

recoverQualifiedHost((bytes32,uint64,byt.notice: Install a strictly newer generation after a recorded Offline. Requires the accepted owner, the         (possibly rotated) operator, and a fresh receipt bound to THIS recovery intent and generation.

releaseHostBudget(bytes32,uint128).notice: Return unencumbered budget to the payer's sponsor funds. While Online the protected reserve stays.         Reimbursements already owed live in `credits` and are never touched here.

reserveBootstrap((bytes32,bytes32,bytes3.notice: Lock payer funds for one candidate. Does NOT list anything or release gas. Bootstrap reservations         (host not yet enrolled) take the hardware's single bootstrap slot; every reservation takes its job id.

setProofKey(bytes32,address).notice: Compatibility no-op only. A different proof key requires fresh qualified recovery.
